criteria.C01: All10 runtime source and24 existing test/fixture files read completely; flat stdlib imports and readonly responsibilities/callers traced. Shared queries, ground-value validators and metadata readers reused; no mechanical split/new abstraction.
criteria.C02: Latest empty fact source suppresses earlier medication/event/vital facts; newest unreadable karte state remains unknown. Date-only JST and aware offsets maintained; terminalZ corrected for3.10. Missing record is not absence of care. Finite/oversized inputs reach stable error paths.
criteria.C03: View opens one readonly published generation/BEGIN and closes reader; no write/job/own connection in stats. UUID/hash conflict and project/actor/application/channel scope checks precede receipt disclosure. Current facts/links do not mutate ledger.
criteria.C04: Supported snapshot user_version5–9 and published DELETE journal/snapshot_meta contract verified. Current v1/legacy/canonical/v4 and metadata shapes preserved; no schema/migration/history rewrite. Core forward migrations are separately audited.
criteria.C05: Bound SQL parameters; project exact positive IDs and snapshot-bound cursor keys/ranges; publication gates, current source/revision and scoped notification receipt enforced. No direct external URL/credentials/authentication changes.
criteria.C06: Temporary DB and wholly invented fixtures only. Stats and aggregate models use IDs/counts and metadata reasons, no bodies/names; QC feedback notes/actor not returned. Receipt scope denial omits foreign detail. No real data/model/Keychain access.
criteria.C07: Public CLI/View/API signatures and defaults unchanged. Limits1–200, cursor<=2048, detail/category/bucket bounds preserved. Invalid numeric option uses existing ValueError code, corrupt receipt existing rejected code. Valid finite values and disabled publication behavior retained.
criteria.C08: Actual readonly JSON consumer and three native-renderer paths checked through caller packets. Stale/source fingerprints and unknown labels explicit; no automatic task adoption/clinical completion. No browser/web/ARIA owner here; actual provider UI remains unexecuted under live boundary.
criteria.C09: Bounded paginated lists, source generation binding and shared current-query predicates checked. Medication selection marks latest per-message before empty filtering and streams SQL rows instead of materializing all text. Snapshot-wide aggregate scans remain intentional; no speed/cost claim.
criteria.C10: Malformed/deep stored JSON cannot stop status, QC, task/loop listings, receipt lookup or stat dispatch; scoped existing unknown/rejection/skip/unavailable behaviors used. Reader finally-close/BEGIN and snapshot identity remain. No retry/resend/job scheduling in this module.
criteria.C11: All existing24 tests and shared fixtures fully reviewed; wholly synthetic snapshots exercise public entries. Accepted22 newcases fixedP3.10 before19fail/3controls, after22pass per runtime. Existing481-family passes both3.13 and3.10; one later test input strengthened and new22 rerun separately, no skipped/weak assertions.
criteria.C12: Stdlib/runtime dependency unchanged. Real isolated Python3.10.22 and3.13.12, project isolated runner, pinned Ruff0.16.10 and diff check used. Runtime TypedDict shared-test collection fix integrated from semantic packet5; SDK/archive/final I gates remain separate.
criteria.X01: Standalone JSON CLI uses existing bootstrap from isolated cwd; published snapshot prerequisite preserved, no live ledger fallback. Installation/update/recovery and archive-wide startup are parent lifecycle/final validation, actual gateway/adapter restart not performed.
criteria.X02: No new runtime dependencies or external fetch in views. Existing stdlib/shared validators; license/pinned SDK supply-chain and CI permissions belong to parent/core records, no deployment/publish authorization inferred.
criteria.X03: Deleted-body/current-generation guards prevent departed facts; newest-empty regression prevents old clinical mentions resurfacing. Old artefacts/requests/receipts untouched. Backup/key/purge/restore owner separately audited; no real deletion.
criteria.X04: Notification receipt lookup consumes composite IDs plus exact actor/app/channel/projects and explicit operator scope; snapshot lag is not failure. Three platform render/SDK owners consume same JSON contracts. No network, signatures or real delivery exercised in views.
criteria.X05: Offline snapshots/temporary paths and supported CPython versions verified; deep-parser differences reproduced in actual3.10. Numeric/JSON capacity/cursor guard retained. Native provider screen, other OS and filesystem durability remain stated external constraints.
criteria.X06: LLM-derived/current candidates only display grounded evidence and require existing human approval caller. Stored arbitrary text is not tool authorization; no model/MCP/eval/provider invocation or memory transfer introduced.
criteria.X07: Clinical unit/value/quote/current-project/subject boundaries reuse authoritative code and full synthetic fixtures. No new medical thresholds/adoption rules; unknown timezone/source/record and quote-supported versus human-confirmed distinction retained.
criteria.X08: No public web server/forms/routes owned; protected source links only known canonical project URL and explicit publication/private scope. Native text renderer/link escaping validated in platform packets; actual public deployment not performed.
